title_zh: Shedler：真正的心理治療不在網路上，借專業頭銜給陌生人建議卻不負責任
title_en: Therapists on social media and professional boundaries
summary_zh: Jonathan Shedler 指出，心理治療需要持續的專業關係、完整的個人史與專注的評估，這些在社群媒體上都不存在。在網路上對陌生人提供類治療建議的專業人員，借用了頭銜的權威，卻不承擔法律與倫理責任；而表面的困擾背後可能藏著創傷、自殺意念或身體疾病，需要完整評估。
summary_en: Jonathan Shedler argues psychotherapy requires an ongoing professional relationship, full history and careful evaluation, none of which exist on social media. Professionals who give therapy-like advice to strangers online borrow the authority of their credentials while assuming no legal or ethical responsibility, and surface complaints may hide trauma, suicidality or medical conditions.
evidence_note: 專業評論文章，以假設情境說明，未引用研究。

ethics_flags.note: 在不了解個案的情況下公開給建議，超出可負責的專業判斷範圍。
網路上的類治療互動模糊了專業關係與公開發言的界線。
作者提醒表面困擾可能隱藏自殺意念，網路回應無法做風險評估。
refs: 危機處理｜自殺與自傷風險

caution: 作者立場鮮明，並非否定所有公共心理教育，重點在不對特定個人給臨床建議。
brief_zh: 治療需要專業關係、完整病史與專注評估
網路建議借用頭銜權威卻不承擔責任
表面問題可能隱藏創傷、自殺風險或醫療問題
稱職的治療者知道自己的界限並會轉介
brief_en: Therapy needs a professional relationship, history and evaluation
Online advice borrows authority without accountability
Presenting problems may hide trauma, suicidality or medical issues
Competent therapists know their limits and refer
supervision_questions: 你在社群媒體上分享心理知識時，如何區分「心理教育」與「給特定個人建議」？
網友私訊求助時，你的標準回應與轉介流程是什麼？
你的個案若在網路上看到你的發文，可能對治療關係產生什麼影響？

posts.title: Real Psychotherapists Don't Act Like Therapists on the Internet
posts.content: Shedler 主張心理治療發生在專業關係中，而非社群媒體；網路上以治療師身分給陌生人建議，借用了專業權威卻不承擔專業責任。

related.title_zh: ACA 支持《Doctors Not AI Act》：保險 AI 不得取代臨床判斷
related.title_en: ACA backs Doctors Not AI Act to curb AI-driven insurance coverage denials
related.summary_zh: 美國諮商學會（ACA）宣布與另外 44 個心理健康與醫療組織共同支持兩黨法案《Doctors Not AI Act》（H.R. 10210）。該法案針對保險公司以 AI、演算法自動審查理賠、決定醫療必要性的做法設下防線：凡需臨床判斷的拒保決定，必須由具適當專長的持牌醫療人員做出，且須提高透明度並考量個人情況。
related.summary_en: On 2 Oct 2026 the American Counseling Association joined 44 other mental-health and medical organizations backing the bipartisan Doctors Not AI Act (H.R. 10210): insurers could not use AI alone to deny coverage, medical-necessity denials would need a licensed professional with appropriate expertise, with more transparency and individual circumstances considered.

related.title_zh: 加州州長否決 SB 903：AI 心理治療限制法案未能成法
related.title_en: Newsom vetoes California SB 903 on AI in therapy
related.summary_zh: 加州州長 Newsom 否決了 SB 903。該法案原本要禁止 AI 演算法提供或宣傳心理治療服務，持照專業人員只能把 AI 用於行政或輔助支援，用 AI 錄製治療會談前須清楚揭露並取得同意，也不准 AI 獨立與個案互動或作治療決定。法案在參議院全票通過、眾議院以 71 比 4 通過；州長的否決理由認為對病人與臨床人員的保護「過了頭」，提案人 Padilla 則強烈批評。
related.summary_en: California Governor Gavin Newsom vetoed SB 903, which would have barred AI from providing or advertising therapy, limited licensed clinicians to administrative or supplementary AI use, required disclosure and consent before AI recording of sessions, and banned AI from independently interacting with clients or making therapeutic decisions. The bill had passed the Senate unanimously and the Assembly 71-4; the veto message said its protections went too far, drawing sharp criticism from author Sen. Steve Padilla.

related.title_zh: 加州簽署三項醫療 AI 法案：AI 只能當顧問、須處理演算法偏誤
related.title_en: California signs three healthcare AI bills
related.summary_zh: 加州州長簽署三項醫療 AI 法案：AB 1979 把 AI 在臨床照護中限於諮詢角色、不得執行需執照的臨床功能，並保護經由聊天機器人取得的病人健康資訊；SB 503 要求醫療 AI 開發者與使用者辨識、減輕並持續監測臨床決策支援系統的偏誤風險；AB 1609 禁止大型企業把客服聊天機器人包裝成真人。同時被否決的有 AB 2575 和處理 AI 心理治療的 SB 903。
related.summary_en: California's governor signed three healthcare AI bills: AB 1979 restricts AI to an advisory role in clinical care, bars it from performing licensed clinical functions and protects health information accessed through chatbots; SB 503 requires developers and deployers to identify, mitigate and monitor bias risks in clinical decision support; AB 1609 bars large enterprises from presenting customer-service chatbots as human. AB 2575 and the AI-in-psychotherapy bill SB 903 were vetoed.
